snippet.title: PlayStation - Pro Wrestling Sengokuden 2 (1998) - Opening
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Pro Wrestling Sengokuden 2 is a Sports game, developed by Dream Japan and published by KSS, which was released in Japan in 1998.
